package main

import (
	"fmt"
	str "strings"
)

// Point is a place on the grid.
type Point struct {
	X, Y int
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

/* area returns
   the product */
func (p *Point) area() float64 {
	return float64(p.X * p.Y)
}

func main() {
	pts := make([]Point, 0, 8)
	for i := range 3 {
		pts = append(pts, Point{X: i, Y: i << 1, Name: str.Repeat("x", i)})
	}
	if len(pts) != 0 && pts[0].Name == "" {
		fmt.Println("empty", nil, true, false, iota)
	}
	var ch chan<- rune = nil
	_ = ch
	x := 0x_FF &^ 0b1010
	x >>= 2
	defer func() { recover() }()
	fmt.Printf("%d %v\n", x, pts)
}
